title: Monotonicity of majority functions
statement: Let $f:\\{-1,1\\}^n\\to\\{-1,1\\}$ agree with the sign of $\\sum_{i=1}^n x_i$ at every input $x$ for which this sum is nonzero; its values when the sum is zero may be arbitrary. Then $f$ is monotone in the coordinatewise order $-1<1$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
At every input with nonzero coordinate sum, $f$ equals the threshold sign of that sum
